entities.name: Thantis
entities.description: Thantis, the Warweaver, a giant malevolent legendary spider from an unknown plane who feeds on creatures enraged by her web of burning mana.

events.summary: Creatures caught in Thantis's web of burning mana seethe in rage and become her food.
events.quote: As these creatures seethe and struggle, they become food for Thantis
